Tips before you order

  • Bulk orders only — every product shows a minimum order quantity (MOQ) and the price per unit drops as quantity rises.
  • To import you need a trade licence that covers the goods and a customs importer code. Most goods pay 5% duty on the CIF value plus 5% import VAT.
  • Cosmetics and food must be registered with Dubai Municipality (or ESMA for cosmetics) before sale; GCC-made goods with a certificate of origin are usually duty-free.
